intro: Kaymard Copperpinch is a goblin merchant representing Smokywood Pastures in Orgrimmar during the Feast of Winter Veil. Stationed in the Valley of Strength, he hawks festive goods and directs travelers toward holiday cheer and missing holiday supplies. His brisk trade brings seasonal merriment—and Goblin commercial enterprise—to the Horde capital.

p: When the Feast of Winter Veil arrives, Smokywood Pastures sets up shop right in the bustling Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar, fronted by the enterprising Kaymard Copperpinch. While Great-father Winter receives visitors nearby, Kaymard makes sure the season remains profitable. Selling higher-end treats, festive wrapping paper, and holiday necessities, he embodies the goblin view that no grand cultural festival is complete without a lively exchange of coin.

Beyond peddling festive wares, Kaymard often serves as a point of contact for the seasonal mishaps that plague Smokywood Pastures. From stolen shipments of holiday confections to the mysterious disappearance of Metzen the Reindeer, Kaymard eagerly enlists Horde adventurers to sort out trouble in the snow and keep the festival running smoothly.
